# function: partnercentral_relationship

Builds the ARN for `partnercentral` `Relationship`:

```
arn:${Partition}:partnercentral:${Region}:${Account}:catalog/${Catalog}/program-management-account/${ProgramManagementAccountId}/relationship/${RelationshipId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:partnercentral:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:catalog/catalog/program-management-account/program-management-account-id/relationship/relationship-id
output "partnercentral_relationship" {
  value = provider::arn::partnercentral_relationship("catalog", "program-management-account-id", "relationship-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
partnercentral_relationship(catalog string, program_management_account_id string, relationship_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `catalog` (String) Value for `${Catalog}` in the ARN template.
1. `program_management_account_id` (String) Value for `${ProgramManagementAccountId}` in the ARN template.
1. `relationship_id` (String) Value for `${RelationshipId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
